newsitem.title: NEPAL: Nepali rupee firms slightly to 56.95/00 per dollar.
newsitem.headline: Nepali rupee firms slightly to 56.95/00 per dollar.

text.p: The Nepali rupee was quoted on Friday in an interbank trading range of 56.95/7.00 to the dollar, firming slightly from 57.00/05 on Thursday, according to rates supplied by the 10 commercial banks active in the forex market.
Bank dealers said there were no transactions on Thursday, and there was a good supply of dollars.
Nepal Rastra Bank, the kingdom's central bank, posted a rupee-dollar rate of 56.75/7.30 for its own transactions, unchanged from Thursday.
Interbank call money was quoted at 9.5-10.00 percent.
